entries.summary: Migrated GD edit form CSS/JS overlay from Code Snippets into class-oha-hld-gd-form.php
entries.notes: Snippet oha-gd-single-form-ui must be DEACTIVATED after this update. Enqueue at priority 99 on is_gd_form_page() only.

entries.summary: Haunt owner discount edit section on GD frontend listing form
entries.notes: Owner or admin only. Fields: active, rate, message, link, start, end. Injected via wp_footer priority 5 then moved into form by JS before fieldset processing so collapsible behavior applies automatically. Nonce: oha_disc_frontend_save.

entries.summary: Discount change history logging and board email notification on frontend save
entries.notes: _oha_disc_history meta: max 10 entries, records date/user/status/rate/message/source. Board notified via wp_mail to claim_email_recipients option or admin_email fallback.

entries.summary: Utilities tab: absorbed gd-core-autocomplete-enhancer and gd-place-count-extended into HLD
entries.notes: Deactivate gd-core-autocomplete-enhancer and gd-place-count-extended once this version is active. Settings: enable_autocomplete, enable_place_count stored in oha_hld_settings.

entries.summary: Standalone autocomplete had unregistered gd_autocomplete_locations AJAX action - now correctly registered
entries.notes: Silent bug in the original gd-core-autocomplete-enhancer plugin - both keyword and location handlers now registered in HLD.

entries.summary: Discount/Deal admin meta box fields on gd_place edit screens (_oha_disc_* keys)
entries.notes: Fields: active, rate, message, link, start, end, bg, color. Same meta keys read by [oha_discounts] shortcode. Admins can manage discount data from listing edit screen.

entries.summary: Added Requires Plugins: geodirectory to plugin header (WP 6.5+ dependency declaration)
oha-home-haunt-hub integration: Hub listings display through HLD template with oha_hh_* meta fallbacks
entries.notes: Mapped: scare_level->fear_level, age_rec->age_restriction, years_running, scene_count, facebook, email, style[]->features. Hub-exclusive: operating_nights, public_visitors, visitor_range_label, builders_notes. No Hub plugin changes required.

entries.summary: Business hours not showing: geodir_get_business_hours() keys are full day names, not abbreviations
entries.notes: API returns ['days']['Monday'...] with 'closed' bool + 'slots'[]['range'] (pre-formatted string). Completely rewrote sidebar rendering to match actual API.

entries.summary: Email anti-spam: reveal-on-click button replaces plain mailto link in sidebar info card
entries.notes: Email split at @ into data-u / data-d attributes. JS assembles mailto on first click. No full address in HTML source.

entries.summary: GD email and business_hours fields displayed in sidebar (email row + weekly hours table)
entries.notes: Today's hours row highlighted dark-red. Times formatted 12-hour. haunt_theme field now rendered as Theme row above Phone.

entries.summary: Video oEmbed not rendering for plain YouTube/Vimeo URLs
entries.notes: Replaced wp_embed->autoembed() with wp_oembed_get() as primary, autoembed with post_ID as secondary, wp_kses_post for raw iframe. Regex guard prevents oEmbed on non-URL strings.

entries.summary: Gallery thumbnails blurry: changed from medium (300px) to large src for background-image
Lightbox CSS added; image preloader with loading state; touch/swipe mobile navigation
entries.notes: Swipe threshold 40px, horizontal-only.

entries.summary: Video section: reads GD video field, converts YouTube/Vimeo via oEmbed, 16:9 responsive wrapper
_oha_hld_override_claimed meta: suppresses unclaimed display state from WP admin meta box
entries.notes: Shown in admin info panel as 'Owner-managed (admin override)' status.

entries.summary: Admin info panel: added Edit (Frontend) and Edit (WP Admin) buttons
entries.notes: Frontend edit uses GD gd_action=edit_post URL.

entries.summary: Field Reference tab in admin: all GD custom fields for gd_place with live value preview by post ID
Nearby haunts: featured-only, haversine distance sort, distance badge. Section renamed to Featured Haunts Nearby.
Full Track B field reads: 20+ GD custom fields, discount meta, is_display_unclaimed flag, gallery fix
entries.notes: Discount meta: _oha_disc_*. Gallery now shows all images, not just 2+. is_display_unclaimed: author=3 && !claimed.

entries.summary: Hero badges, unclaimed state, fear level pill, haunt type pill; main-content features, stats, visitor tips, recruiting
Claim section replaced button_html() with section_html(): full context-aware rendering for all owner states
entries.notes: States: admin info panel, author You Own This, real-user claimed hidden, unclaimed claim prompt.

entries.summary: Admin settings page with Display and Claim tabs under GeoDirectory > OHA Listing Display
Integrated claim workflow: hidden CPT, AJAX submit, approve/reject, email notifications, pending count badge
entries.notes: Compatible with gd-claim-via-reports meta keys. Deactivate gd-claim-via-reports when using HLD.

entries.summary: Initial plugin: GD single listing template override with hero, 2-col layout, gallery, nearby, OHA dark theme CSS
entries.notes: Template: content-single.php + partials. Override via geodir_overwrite_single_template_content filter.

entries.summary: Tiered discount bar: promo code and private link visible to OHA paid members only
entries.notes: PHP-gated: promo code and private link never appear in HTML source for non-members. Member check uses oha_member_id usermeta (canonical for all active members). Teaser shown to non-members with smart join link: basic members go to /my-membership/, non-logged-in go to /register/.

entries.summary: Promo code and private link fields added to HLD admin meta box and GD frontend owner edit form
entries.notes: Meta keys: _oha_disc_promo_code (sanitize_text_field), _oha_disc_private_link (esc_url_raw). Saved in both class-oha-hld-admin.php save_meta_box() and class-oha-hld-gd-form.php save_discount().

entries.summary: Moved discount notice above the hero image for immediate visibility on page load
entries.notes: Block now renders before include hero.php in content-single.php (Option D positioning).

entries.summary: Redesigned discount notice as two-column card with OHA Member Discount label and 30px rate text
entries.notes: Removed __inner/__icon elements. New structure: __card (flex row), __main (left col with label+rate+msg), __members (right col, vertical gold divider). Rate 14px gold -> 30px white Cinzel. Label is Cinzel small caps gold. Members uses __members-header wrapper. Mobile stacks at 600px.

entries.summary: Moved discount card back below the hero image
entries.notes: Reverted v1.9.0 positioning change. Discount notice now renders after hero.php, before .oha-listing-body.

entries.summary: Social buttons switched to 2-column grid with white-space:nowrap to prevent text wrapping
entries.notes: Changed .oha-social from display:flex to display:grid with repeat(2,1fr). Added white-space:nowrap and tightened padding on .oha-social__btn. Removed flex:1 (not needed in grid context).

entries.summary: Discount rate badge shown on nearby featured haunt cards when discount is active
entries.notes: Reads _oha_disc_active, _oha_disc_rate, _oha_disc_start, _oha_disc_end per nearby card. Badge shows rate + Member Discount label below title. Uses  from parent content-single.php scope. CSS class: .oha-nearby__discount (gold, Rajdhani, subtle border).

tabs: Display Settings: feature toggles (claim, report, gallery, nearby, mobile bar), nearby count
Claim Settings: heading/body/button text, email from/recipients, submit email, approval email
Pending Claims: approve/reject queue with pending count badge
Field Reference: all GD custom fields for gd_place, with live value preview by post ID

v1.0.0_audit_corrections.correct_value: Comma , separator (confirmed from implode(",",$value) in save logic)
